claims.evidence: Witness only saw the motorcycle parked; no running/starting/idling test shown.
Witness report does not show any readable brand/model badge or clear identification.
No functional checks (start, lights, brakes, gears, clutch) were reported.
No receipt/registration date or odometer/mileage evidence shown.
No ride test or brake/gear/clutch inspection details shown.
Only general exterior appearance is described; no close-up of frame/engine areas.
No parts/serial verification or close-ups of components shown.

risks.risk: Unclear engine/running condition (may not start, may idle poorly, may smoke/noise).
risks.proof: Short video of cold start + 2–3 minutes idling + brief throttle rev, showing no abnormal smoke/noise.
risks.if_unproven: Price as a non-verified running bike (worst-case: needs engine/service) until start/idle is demonstrated.

risks.risk: Brand/model may not actually be Suzuki (misidentification from limited angles).
risks.proof: Clear close-up photos of tank/logo/badge + both side panels + any model plate/engine number area.
risks.if_unproven: Price at the lowest generic motorcycle value for the visible type, not assuming Suzuki.

risks.risk: Brake system condition unknown (front/rear brakes may be weak, pads worn, or hydraulics/cables faulty).
risks.proof: Video clip of a safe stop test: front brake squeeze + rear brake press, showing strong stopping and no dragging.
risks.if_unproven: Price as brakes may need service/parts replacement.

risks.risk: Tires and wheel condition unknown (tread depth, punctures, whether tires hold air).
risks.proof: Close-up of front and rear tire tread + check showing tire pressure/valve condition (or a quick ride showing no wobble).
risks.if_unproven: Price assuming tires may be worn or need replacement.

risks.risk: Clutch/gearbox/chain-sprocket wear unknown (may slip, hard shifting, chain stretched).
risks.proof: Video of gear changes while stationary (clutch engagement) + chain/sprocket close-up showing wear.
risks.if_unproven: Price assuming drivetrain service may be required.

risks.risk: Electricals may not work (headlight, indicators, horn, brake light).
risks.proof: Photo/video showing all lights on: headlight, both indicators, horn, and brake light test.
risks.if_unproven: Price assuming electrical troubleshooting/repairs may be needed.

risks.risk: Frame/accident damage or misalignment not visible from the single roadside angle.
risks.proof: Walk-around photos from both sides + straight-line check (wheel alignment) and close-ups of frame welds/cracks.
risks.if_unproven: Price as possible hidden damage until alignment/frame condition is confirmed.

risks.risk: Ownership/registration/engine-frame numbers not shown (could be stolen or not properly documented).
risks.proof: Clear photos of registration papers + engine number and frame/VIN plate (matching documents).
risks.if_unproven: Price at a worst-case legal/ownership risk discount until documents are verified.

risks.risk: Fuel tank rust/leaks and oil/fuel seepage unknown.
risks.proof: Close-up of tank (inside cap area if possible) + check for wetness around engine, hoses, and undercarriage.
risks.if_unproven: Price assuming possible leaks/rust requiring cleaning/repair.

proof_requests: Clear photos of brand/model badges and any model plate (tank/logo/side panel) to confirm it is Suzuki.
Video of cold start, 2–3 minutes idling, and a short throttle test (no abnormal smoke/noise).
Brake test video (front and rear) showing strong stopping and no dragging.
Close-up photos of front and rear tires (tread + valve) and confirmation tires hold air.
Video of gear changes while stationary (clutch engagement) plus chain/sprocket close-ups.
Video/photo showing headlight, indicators, horn, and brake light working.
Photos of engine number and frame/VIN plate plus registration papers for ownership verification.
Close-up of fuel tank and checks for oil/fuel leaks around engine and hoses.
response.reason: The witness confirms it is a motorcycle with some visible exterior features, but key details needed to price safely (brand/model confirmation, running condition, brakes/clutch, tires, electricals, and documentation) are not shown. Request the specific proof items before pricing.
